versos.hebraico: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְחָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנָ֣ה לְ֠גָלוּתֵנוּ בְּרֹ֨אשׁ הַשָּׁנָ֜ה בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכְּתָ֖ה הָעִ֑יר בְּעֶ֣צֶם׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עָלַי֙ יַד־יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was struck, in the same day, the hand of Yahweh was on me, and he brought me there.
controles.kjv: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me thither.
controles.livre: No vigésimo quinto ano de nosso cativeiro, no princípio do ano, aos dez do mês, aos catorze anos depois que a cidade foi ferida, naquele mesmo dia veio sobre mim a mão do SENHOR, e me levou para lá.

versos.hebraico: בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֔ים הֱבִיאַ֖נִי אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְנִיחֵ֗נִי אֶל־הַ֤ר גָּבֹ֨הַּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְעָלָ֥יו כְּמִבְנֵה־עִ֖יר מִנֶּֽגֶב׃

controles.web: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.
controles.kjv: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
controles.livre: Em visões de Deus me levou à terra de Israel, e me pôs sobre um monte muito alto, sobre o qual havia como um edifício de uma cidade ao sul.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֵ֨יא אוֹתִ֜י שָׁ֗מָּה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ֙ מַרְאֵ֨הוּ֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וּפְתִיל־פִּשְׁתִּ֥ים בְּיָד֖וֹ וּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה וְה֥וּא עֹמֵ֖ד בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃

controles.web: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
controles.kjv: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
controles.livre: E havendo me levado ali, eis um homem cuja aparência era como a aparência de bronze, e tinha um cordel de linho em sua mão, e uma cana de medir; e ele estava em pé à porta.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלַ֜י הָאִ֗ישׁ בֶּן־אָדָ֡ם רְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶיךָ֩ וּבְאָזְנֶ֨יךָ שְּׁמָ֜ע וְשִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֗ לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לְמַ֥עַן הַרְאוֹתְכָ֖ה הֻבָ֣אתָה הֵ֑נָּה הַגֵּ֛ד אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The man said to me, Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I shall show you; for, to the intent that I may show them to you, you are brought here: declare all that you see to the house of Israel.
controles.kjv: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
controles.livre: E aquele homem me falou: Filho do homem, olha com teus olhos, ouve com teus ouvidos, e põe teu coração em tudo quanto eu te mostrar, pois foste trazido aqui para que eu te mostrasse. Anuncia, pois, à casa de Israel tudo o que vires.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֥ה חוֹמָ֛ה מִח֥וּץ לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וּבְיַ֨ד הָאִ֜ישׁ קְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֤וֹת בָּֽאַמָּה֙ וָטֹ֔פַח וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־רֹ֤חַב הַבִּנְיָן֙ קָנֶ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וְקוֹמָ֖ה קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Behold, a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand breadth each: so he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
controles.kjv: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
controles.livre: E eis, um muro fora do templo  ao redor; e na mão daquele homem uma cana de medir de seis côvados, cada côvado de um côvado e um palmo; e mediu a largura do edifício de uma cana, e a altura, de outra cana.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־שַׁ֨עַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֔ימָה וַיַּ֖עַל במעלותו וַיָּ֣מָד׀ אֶת־סַ֣ף הַשַּׁ֗עַר קָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֵת֙ סַ֣ף אֶחָ֔ד קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד רֹֽחַב׃

controles.web: Then came he to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps: and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed broad; and the other threshold, one reed broad.
controles.kjv: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.
controles.livre: Então ele veio à porta que estava voltada para o oriente, subiu por seus degraus, e mediu o umbral da porta de uma cana de largura, e o outro umbral de outra cana de largura.

versos.hebraico: וְהַתָּ֗א קָנֶ֨ה אֶחָ֥ד אֹ֨רֶךְ֙ וְקָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וּבֵ֥ין הַתָּאִ֖ים חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְסַ֣ף הַ֠שַּׁעַר מֵאֵ֨צֶל אוּלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵֽהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Every lodge was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the lodges was five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.
controles.kjv: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
controles.livre: E cada câmara tinha uma cana de comprimento, e uma cana de largo; e entre as câmaras eram cinco côvados; e o umbral da porta junto ao alpendre da porta por dentro, uma cana.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
controles.kjv: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
controles.livre: Também mediu o alpendre da porta por de dentro, uma cana.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֨עַר֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה אַמּ֔וֹת ואילו שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְאֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר מֵהַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.
controles.kjv: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
controles.livre: Então mediu o alpendre da porta, de oito côvados, e seus pilares de dois côvados; e o alpendre da porta por dentro.

versos.hebraico: וְתָאֵ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֗ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה מִפֹּה֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפֹּ֔ה מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּ֑ם וּמִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָאֵילִ֖ם מִפֹּ֥ה וּמִפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The lodges of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
controles.kjv: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
controles.livre: E as câmaras pequenas da porta do oriente eram três de um lado e três do outro; todas as três de uma mesma medida; também os pilares de um lado e do outro tinham uma mesma medida.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֛מָד אֶת־רֹ֥חַב פֶּֽתַח־הַשַּׁ֖עַר עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֑וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁל֥וֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: He measured the breadth of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;
controles.kjv: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
controles.livre: E mediu a largura da entrada da porta, de dez côvados; o comprimento do portal era de treze côvados.

versos.hebraico: וּגְב֞וּל לִפְנֵ֤י הַתָּאוֹת֙ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאַמָּה־אַחַ֥ת גְּב֖וּל מִפֹּ֑ה וְהַתָּ֕א שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֣וֹת מִפּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the lodges, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
controles.kjv: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
controles.livre: E o espaço de diante das câmaras pequenas era de um côvado de um lado, e de um côvado do outro lado; e cada câmara tinha seis côvados de um lado, e seis côvados do outro.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־הַשַּׁ֗עַר מִגַּ֤ג הַתָּא֙ לְגַגּ֔וֹ רֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת פֶּ֖תַח נֶ֥גֶד פָּֽתַח׃

controles.web: He measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a breadth of twenty-five cubits; door against door.
controles.kjv: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
controles.livre: Então mediu a porta desde o teto da uma câmara pequena até o teto da outra, vinte e cinco côvados de largura, porta contra porta.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־אֵילִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְאֶל־אֵיל֙ הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר הַשַּׁ֖עַר סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He made also posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
controles.kjv: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
controles.livre: Também fez medição com os pilares de sessenta côvados, o pilar do pátio ao redor da porta.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֗ל פְּנֵי֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר היאתון עַל־לִפְנֵ֕י אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר הַפְּנִימִ֑י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
controles.kjv: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
controles.livre: E desde a dianteira da porta de entrada até a dianteira do alpendre da porta interior havia cinquenta côvados.

versos.hebraico: וְחַלֹּנ֣וֹת אֲטֻמ֣וֹת אֶֽל־הַתָּאִ֡ים וְאֶל֩ אֵלֵיהֵ֨מָה לִפְנִ֤ימָה לַשַּׁ֨עַר֙ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב וְכֵ֖ן לָאֵֽלַמּ֑וֹת וְחַלּוֹנ֞וֹת סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ לִפְנִ֔ימָה וְאֶל־אַ֖יִל תִּמֹרִֽים׃

controles.web: There were closed windows to the lodges, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches; and windows were around inward; and on each post were palm trees.
controles.kjv: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.
controles.livre: Havia também janelas estreitas nas câmaras pequenas, e em seus pilares por dentro ao redor da porta, e assim também nos alpendres; e as janelas estavam ao redor por dentro; e em cada poste havia palmeiras.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִיאֵ֗נִי אֶל־הֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה לְשָׁכוֹת֙ וְרִֽצְפָ֔ה עָשׂ֥וּי לֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים לְשָׁכ֖וֹת אֶל־הָרִֽצְפָֽה׃

controles.web: Then brought he me into the outer court; and behold, there were rooms and a pavement, made for the court all around: thirty rooms were on the pavement.
controles.kjv: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
controles.livre: Então me levou ao átrio exterior, e eis que havia nele câmaras, e um pavimento feito no pátio ao redor; trinta câmaras havia naquele pavimento.

versos.hebraico: וְהָרִֽצְפָה֙ אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְעֻמַּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים הָרִֽצְפָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: The pavement was by the side of the gates, answerable to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
controles.kjv: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
controles.livre: E o pavimento ao lado das portas era equivalente ao comprimento das portas ( este era o pavimento inferior).

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣מָד רֹ֡חַב מִלִּפְנֵי֩ הַשַּׁ֨עַר הַתַּחְתּ֜וֹנָה לִפְנֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֧ר הַפְּנִימִ֛י מִח֖וּץ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה הַקָּדִ֖ים וְהַצָּפֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
controles.kjv: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
controles.livre: E mediu a largura desde a dianteira da porta inferior até a dianteira do pátio interior pelo lado de fora: cem côvados pelo oriente e pelo norte.

versos.hebraico: וְהַשַּׁ֗עַר אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה מָדַ֥ד אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְרָחְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The gate of the outer court whose prospect is toward the north, he measured its length and its breadth.
controles.kjv: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
controles.livre: E quanto à porta que estava voltada para o norte no átrio exterior, mediu seu comprimento e sua largura.

versos.hebraico: ותאו שְׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה מִפּוֹ֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפּ֔וֹ ואילו ואלמו הָיָ֔ה כְּמִדַּ֖ת הַשַּׁ֣עַר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים בָּאַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side; and its posts and its arches were after the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
controles.kjv: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
controles.livre: E suas câmaras pequenas eram três de um lado, e três de outro; e seus pilares e seus alpendres eram da mesma medida da primeira porta: cinquenta côvados era seu comprimento, e a largura era de vinte e cinco côvados.

versos.hebraico: וחלונו ואלמו ותמרו כְּמִדַּ֣ת הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּבְמַעֲל֥וֹת שֶׁ֨בַע֙ יַֽעֲלוּ־ב֔וֹ ואילמו לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The windows of it, and its arches, and the palm trees of it, were after the measure of the gate whose prospect is toward the east; and they went up to it by seven steps; and its arches were before them.
controles.kjv: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
controles.livre: E suas janelas, e seus alpendres, e suas palmeiras, eram da medida da porta que estava voltada para o oriente; e subiam a ela por sete degraus; e seus alpendres eram diante deles.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁ֨עַר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י נֶ֣גֶד הַשַּׁ֔עַר לַצָּפ֖וֹן וְלַקָּדִ֑ים וַיָּ֧מָד מִשַּׁ֛עַר אֶל־שַׁ֖עַר מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east; and he measured from gate to gate one hundred cubits.
controles.kjv: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
controles.livre: E havia uma porta do pátio interior que ficava em frente da porta ao norte; e assim também outra ao oriente; e mediu de porta a porta cem côvados.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֨נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם וְהִנֵּה־שַׁ֖עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם וּמָדַ֤ד אילו ואילמו כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: He led me toward the south; and behold, a gate toward the south: and he measured its posts and its arches according to these measures.
controles.kjv: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
controles.livre: Então me levou em direção ao sul, e eis que havia uma porta para o sul; e mediu seus pilares e seus alpendres, conforme a estas medidas.

versos.hebraico: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים ל֤וֹ ולאילמו סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב כְּהַחֲלֹּנ֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
controles.kjv: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
controles.livre: E também tinha janelas, assim com havia janelas nos seus alpendres ao redor; o comprimento era de cinquenta côvados, e a largura de vinte e cinco côvados.

versos.hebraico: וּמַעֲל֤וֹת שִׁבְעָה֙ עלותו ואלמו לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִמֹרִ֣ים ל֗וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מִפּ֛וֹ וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפּ֖וֹ אֶל־אילו׃

controles.web: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them; and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.
controles.kjv: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
controles.livre: E suas subidas eram de sete degraus, com seus alpendres diante deles; e tinha palmeiras de um lado e do outro em seus pilares.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁ֛עַר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם וַיָּ֨מָד מִשַּׁ֧עַר אֶל־הַשַּׁ֛עַר דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַדָּר֖וֹם מֵאָ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.
controles.kjv: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
controles.livre: Também havia uma porta no pátio interior voltada para o sul; e mediu de porta a porta para o sul, cem côvados.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל־חָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַדָּר֑וֹם וַיָּ֨מָד֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּר֔וֹם כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
controles.kjv: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
controles.livre: Então ele me levou ao pátio interior pela porta do sul; e mediu a porta do sul conforme a estas medidas.

versos.hebraico: ותאו ואילו ואלמו כַּמִּדּ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛וֹ ולאלמו סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and its lodges, and its posts, and its arches, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in its arches all around; it was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits broad.
controles.kjv: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
controles.livre: E suas câmaras pequenas, e seus pilares e seus alpendres eram conforme a estas medidas; e também tinham janelas ao redor de seus alpendres; o comprimento era de cinquenta côvados, e de a largura de vinte e cinco côvados.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵֽלַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֗רֶךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long, and five cubits broad.
controles.kjv: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
controles.livre: E os alpendres ao redor eram de vinte e cinco côvados de comprimento e cinco côvados de largura.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵלַמָּ֗ו אֶל־חָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣צוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֖ים אֶל־אילו וּמַעֲל֥וֹת שְׁמוֹנֶ֖ה מעלו׃

controles.web: The arches of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
controles.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
controles.livre: E seus alpendres estavam no pátio externo, com palmeiras em seus pilares; e suas subidas eram de oito degraus.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־הַשַּׁ֔עַר כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: He brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures;
controles.kjv: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
controles.livre: Depois me levou ao pátio interior, para o oriente, e mediu a porta conforme a estas medidas;

versos.hebraico: ותאו ואלו ואלמו כַּמִּדּ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛וֹ ולאלמו סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: and its lodges, and its posts, and its arches, according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in its arches all around; it was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits broad.
controles.kjv: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
controles.livre: Assim como suas câmaras pequenas, seus pilares, e seus alpendres, conforme a estas medidas; e também tinha suas janelas ao redor de seus alpendres; o comprimento era de cinquenta côvados, e a largura de vinte e cinco côvados.

versos.hebraico: ואלמו לֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל־אלו מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מעלו׃

controles.web: The arches of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
controles.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
controles.livre: E seus alpendres estavam no pátio externo, com palmeiras em seus postes de um lado e do outro; e suas subidas eram de oito degraus.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֑וֹן וּמָדַ֖ד כַּמִּדּ֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: He brought me to the north gate: and he measured it according to these measures;
controles.kjv: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;
controles.livre: Então me levou à porta do norte, e mediu conforme a estas medidas;

versos.hebraico: תאו אלו ואלמו וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: its lodges, its posts, and its arches: and there were windows therein all around; the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
controles.kjv: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
controles.livre: Suas câmaras pequenas, seus pilares, e seus arcos, também tinham janelas ao redor; o comprimento era de cinquenta côvados, e a largura de vinte e cinco côvados.

versos.hebraico: ואילו לֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל־אילו מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מעלו׃

controles.web: The posts of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
controles.kjv: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
controles.livre: E seus pilares estavam no pátio exterior, com palmeiras em seus pilares de um lado e do outro; e suas subidas eram de oito degraus.

versos.hebraico: וְלִשְׁכָּ֣ה וּפִתְחָ֔הּ בְּאֵילִ֖ים הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים שָׁ֖ם יָדִ֥יחוּ אֶת־הָעֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates; there they washed the burnt offering.
controles.kjv: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
controles.livre: E sua câmara e sua porta estavam junto dos pilares das portas, onde lavavam a oferta de queima.

versos.hebraico: וּבְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֗עַר שְׁנַ֤יִם שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה לִשְׁח֤וֹט אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָעוֹלָ֔ה וְהַחַטָּ֖את וְהָאָשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
controles.kjv: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
controles.livre: E no alpendre da porta havia duas mesas da um lado, e outras duas do outro, para nelas degolar a oferta de queima, o sacrifício pelo pecado, e o pela culpa.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־הַכָּתֵ֣ף מִח֗וּצָה לָעוֹלֶה֙ לְפֶ֨תַח֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹנָה שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֑וֹת וְאֶל־הַכָּתֵ֣ף הָאַחֶ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ לְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.
controles.kjv: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.
controles.livre: E ao lado de fora da subida para a entrada da porta do norte havia duas mesas; e do outro lado que estava no alpendre da porta, havia duas mesas.

versos.hebraico: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה שֻׁלְחָנ֜וֹת מִפֹּ֗ה וְאַרְבָּעָ֧ה שֻׁלְחָנ֛וֹת מִפֹּ֖ה לְכֶ֣תֶף הַשָּׁ֑עַר שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֥ם יִשְׁחָֽטוּ׃

controles.web: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they killed the sacrifices.
controles.kjv: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.
controles.livre: Quatro mesas de um lado, e quatro mesas do outro lado, junto à porta; oito mesas, sobre as quais degolavam.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ שֻׁלְחָנ֨וֹת לָעוֹלָ֜ה אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֗ית אֹרֶךְ֩ אַמָּ֨ה אַחַ֤ת וָחֵ֨צִי֙ וְרֹ֨חַב אַמָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וָחֵ֔צִי וְגֹ֖בַהּ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וְיַנִּ֤יחוּ אֶת־הַכֵּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחֲט֧וּ אֶת־הָעוֹלָ֛ה בָּ֖ם וְהַזָּֽבַח׃

controles.web: There were four tables for the burnt offering, of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high; whereupon they laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
controles.kjv: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
controles.livre: E as quatro mesas para a oferta de queima eram de pedras lavradas, de um côvado e meio de comprimento, e um côvado e meio de largura, e um côvado de altura; sobre elas eram postos os instrumentos com que degolavam a oferta de queima e o sacrifício.

versos.hebraico: וְהַֽשְׁפַתַּ֗יִם טֹ֧פַח אֶחָ֛ד מוּכָנִ֥ים בַּבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאֶל־הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֥ר הַקָּרְבָֽן׃

controles.web: The hooks, a hand breadth long, were fastened within all around: and on the tables was the flesh of the offering.
controles.kjv: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.
controles.livre: E havia ganchos de um palmo, dispostos por dentro ao redor; e sobre as mesas a carne da oferta.

versos.hebraico: וּמִחוּצָה֩ לַשַּׁ֨עַר הַפְּנִימִ֜י לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת שָׁרִ֗ים בֶּחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֗ר אֶל־כֶּ֨תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם אֶחָ֗ד אֶל־כֶּ֨תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַקָּדִ֔ים פְּנֵ֖י דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַצָּפֹֽן׃

controles.web: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south; one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
controles.kjv: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
controles.livre: E de fora da porta interior estavam as câmaras dos cantores no pátio de dentro que era do lado da porta do norte; as quais estavam voltadas para o sul; uma estava ao lado da porta do oriente que estava voltada para o norte.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָ֑י זֹ֣ה הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֨יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: He said to me, This room, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the house;
controles.kjv: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
controles.livre: E me falou: Esta câmara que está voltada para o sul é para os sacerdotes que têm a guarda do templo.

versos.hebraico: וְהַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֨יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הֵ֣מָּה בְנֵֽי־צָד֗וֹק הַקְּרֵבִ֧ים מִבְּנֵֽי־לֵוִ֛י אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and the room whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.
controles.kjv: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the Lord to minister unto him.
controles.livre: Mas a câmara que está voltada para o norte é para os sacerdotes que têm a guarda do altar; estes são os filhos de Zadoque, dentre os filhos de Levi os que se achegam ao SENHOR, para o servir.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה מְרֻבָּ֑עַת וְהַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits broad, square; and the altar was before the house.
controles.kjv: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.
controles.livre: E mediu o pátio, cem côvados de comprimento, e cem côvados de largura, quadrado; e o altar estava diante do templo.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִאֵנִי֮ אֶל־אֻלָ֣ם הַבַּיִת֒ וַיָּ֨מָד֙ אֵ֣ל אֻלָ֔ם חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפֹּ֔ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה וְרֹ֣חַב הַשַּׁ֔עַר שָׁלֹ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
controles.kjv: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
controles.livre: Então ele me levou ao alpendre do templo, e mediu cada pilar do alpendre, cinco côvados de um lado, e cinco côvados do outro; e a largura da porta era três côvados de um lado, e três côvados do outro.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֣רֶךְ הָאֻלָ֞ם עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֨חַב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה וּבַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲל֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו וְעַמֻּדִים֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֵילִ֔ים אֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּ֖ה וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּֽה׃

controles.web: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; even by the steps by which they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
controles.kjv: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
controles.livre: O comprimento do alpendre era vinte côvados, e a largura onze côvados; e era com degraus, pelos quais se subia; e havia colunas junto aos pilares, uma de um lado, e outra do outro.
